json_compaction_policy: SOURCE_HEALTH.json stores sortable source-health summaries only; canonical titles/URLs live in sources/source_keys.json, manual prose in metadata/source_health.json, and dependency detail is derivable from source_catalog, claims, case_packets, and note_metadata.

default_policy.coverage: Every source key appears in generated/SOURCE_HEALTH.*; metadata/source_health.json stores manual health notes only where the source is current, volatile, supersession-prone, newly added, or otherwise important.
default_policy.network_check_policy: Offline builds do not fetch URLs. Use tools/audit_source_health.py separately for URL status, redirects, and retrieval evidence.
default_policy.rev0769_backfill_note: All source keys now carry at least a manual source-health posture. Rows marked catalog_dependency_backfill_not_live_url_fetch are not live URL checks; generated/SOURCE_HEALTH.* separates direct-review coverage from catalog-triage coverage.
default_policy.rev0770_direct_refresh_note: Rev0770 moves the highest-risk catalog-triaged rows into direct-review posture where web search/open evidence was resolved during the revision; unresolved catalog rows remain queued rather than relabeled.
default_policy.rev0771_direct_refresh_note: Rev0771 moves another high-risk catalog-triaged tranche into direct-review posture, while preserving blocked direct-open and official-search cases as retrieval-result facts rather than clean live-check claims.
default_policy.rev0772_direct_refresh_note: Rev0772 moved another priority tranche from catalog-only posture into direct-review or explicit follow-up-capture posture; direct-review coverage still does not equal reliance sufficiency.
default_policy.rev0773_direct_refresh_note: Rev0773 closes the remaining catalog-triage queue while separating clean direct review from blocked/sparse/PDF/search-only follow-up capture; 100% direct-review posture is not reliance-ready posture.
default_policy.rev0773_reliance_warning: Any direct-refresh row still marked needs_followup_capture must be recaptured before excerpt-level citation, legal reliance, or page-specific claim use.
default_policy.rev0774: Separated ordinary review-clock risk from capture-needed risk; closed official page/PDF/index routes where page-level evidence was available and kept only unresolved blocked or legal-text routes in follow-up capture.
default_policy.rev0781: Rev0781 adds emergency-service service-home sources and keeps newly added California NG911 routes as source-boundary evidence: official project pages and investigative/public-records reporting do not prove live rescue, statewide repair, PSAP readiness, or outage harmlessness.
default_policy.rev0782: Rev0782 adds digital-administrative service-home source routes for GOV.UK One Login. Use them as source-boundary evidence about connected-service scope, support, technical configuration, HMRC/DWP rollout, and digital government posture; do not treat them as proof of service completion, fallback sufficiency, representative access, deadline protection, or lived service continuity.
default_policy.rev0783: Rev0783 adds NYC MyCity local digital service-home source routes. Use them as source-boundary evidence about portal posture, business FAQ claims, OTI project messaging, audit findings, and chatbot risk; do not treat them as proof of completed one-stop service, agency accountability, fallback sufficiency, benefit issuance, childcare placement, permit issuance, or lived service continuity.
